messages:
Sam: rolling out release/2028-03-sdk-v1.13 — includes new paging/streaming frame header (compact framing). Starting canary in us-west-2 (ng-canary-7). tagging @oncall for awareness.

Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in 500s for /v1/paged-stream (canary subset ng-canary-7, us-west-2). 60s window: error rate 18% (baseline ~0.3%).

Priya: seeing same in logs. errors look like 'handshake: unexpected frame type 0x07' from runtime serving layer. grabbing logs and heap of examples. suspects client/server frame mismatch after v1.13 bump.

Mike: copying logs here:```
2028-03-15T16:45:10Z ERROR handshake id=0x3f3 client=svc-frontend-22 frame=0x07 expected=0x01
2028-03-15T16:45:11Z WARN  conn-id=abcd closing connection due to codec error
```

Jordan: can we hold the rollout? kill-switch ff-paging-newframe exists — we can flip to legacy. recommend kill + rollback on canary. @Sam can you pause CI/CD canary job?

Sam: pausing rollout now. CI job halted.

Oncall Bot: @Sam acknowledged. Paging oncall flagged: @Priya is oncall.

Priya: executing mitigation plan: 1) flip ff-paging-newframe -> false for canary, 2) rollback canary hosts to sdk v1.12, 3) monitor errors/latency. Doing step 1 now.

Jordan: command to flip feature flag:```bash
redwood feature-flags set ff-paging-newframe false --scope canary --env prod --actor jordan
```

Priya: ff toggled to false for ng-canary-7 :white_check_mark: (propagated to edge).

Mike: config pushed to gatekeeper. starting rolling rollback of canary to v1.12 image. will do n=3 hosts at a time.

Incident Bot: Action logged: feature flag change by Jordan (ff-paging-newframe=false) and rollout paused by Sam.

Priya: rollback in progress. patched canary host list: ng-canary-7a/7b/7c -> image v1.12.

Sam: FYI support: early telemetry shows ~120 failed requests in window; looks like 3 distinct customers saw 500s for a short period (10-12 minutes). tagging @Alex to coordinate customer comms if needed.

Alex: on it. reaching out to Support to draft a proactive note. short note: "Brief interruption to paged streaming for a small set of canary customers; fixes applied; monitoring shows recovery."

Mike: rollback of all canary hosts to v1.12 complete. verifying metrics...

Priya: error rate back to baseline for canary group :white_check_mark:. 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 0.4% within 2 minutes. latency stable.

Sam: re-enabling canary gating: will gate any further rollout until postmortem and compatibility test added to CI.

Jordan: root cause theory: the v1.13 SDK introduced a compact streaming frame header that older server builds didn't tolerate. the canary environment still had some older routing / shim that expected legacy frame types. variant mismatch triggered handshake failure.

Mike: immediate mitigation = kill-switch + rollback. next steps: revert SDK change or add backward-compatible decoder in serving runtime + compatibility tests. also add deterministic canary gating checks for frame header negotiation in CI.

Oncall Bot: Handoff reminder: next oncall at 18:00 UTC — @Alex will take over monitoring and follow-ups.

Priya: creating a ticket for postmortem and follow-up items. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2028 (owner: Priya, co-owner: Mike). ETA for postmortem draft EOD tomorrow.

Sam: FYI to product/security: no PII observed in error samples. telemetry sanitized.

Alex: support notified customers A, B, C with a summary and SEs are looped. will prepare a short customer-facing blurb and send.

Mike: adding regression test to the release checklist to verify frame header negotiation across mixed-version fleets. also adding an automated smoke test that sends a legacy-framed handshake.

Priya: confirmers: monitoring dashboards show stable for 30m. will keep thread open for final sign-off.

Sam: thanks everyone — nice quick mitigation. leaving note to attach logs and exact host IDs to the JIRA ticket. tagging :eyes: for postmortem review.

Incident Bot: Incident status -> mitigated (ff toggled + rollback). Next: postmortem scheduled.

Alex: taking handoff. I'll keep eyes on RPS/5xx for another hour then mark incident closed. postmortem owners will update ticket.

Sam: closing after 60m clean window.

(Reaction notes: many :thumbsup: and :eyes: on the thread)
